poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to refresh the tracked duration and week/month/year totals.

overtime_hours.label: Overtime threshold (hours)
overtime_hours.description: Tracked hours today above which the widget switches to the overtime color.

panel_time_format.label: Panel time format
panel_time_format.description: Format of the panel's week/month/year/day totals. Placeholders: {hours}, {minutes}.

bar_time_format.label: Bar time format
bar_time_format.description: Format of the tracked duration shown in the bar. Placeholders: {hours}, {minutes}.

label_color.label: Label color
label_color.description: Duration text color while under the overtime threshold.

label_overtime_color.label: Label overtime color
label_overtime_color.description: Duration text color once today's tracked time passes the overtime threshold.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.description: Bar display size of the Timewarrior logo, in pixels.

hide_when_inactive.label: Hide when not tracking
hide_when_inactive.description: Remove the widget from the bar while no time is being tracked. When off, it stays in place and shows a pause icon instead.
